headline: The plaza thinks
lede: Grind City's autopilot stopped reciting and started searching: a fourth attract style rolls candidate trick plans through the real sim and commits only what it proves — and the searched line scores deeper than the recorded one.

notes.text: #3394 (PR #3400, 6335e70): search.js — full sim clone, forward rollouts at the kicker, coping, rail and every landing, PROVEN AIR (a gap pop commits only when the rollout actually clears the trench). The searched line wins every tested seed, zero bails, 29 s, and banks a Flip + Manual180 the scripted witness never throws (20702 vs 18910).
grindcheck ALL GREEN with 22/22 mutants dying (+clone, need, sched, searchwire); gcdrive DRIVE GREEN 68 legs incl. live plan/commit counters on ?style=3.

Warden TARGET #3336 was refused (slot b held it live — they shipped it meanwhile); the ladder ran clean to the never-dry rung: weakestStage pointed at Grind City's fixed-bot gap and it closed. QA tail #3401 filed for the thinking-bot surfaces.
Lesson banked: horizon caps are a search's honesty radius — the searcher only got good once its rollouts could see letters land ~120 ticks after a landing.
